say:1:1122540001:1.text: Ah! You must be the one who came to help with our terrabird problem.
say:1:1122540001:1.source_cn: 啊！你一定是来协助我们寻找陆行鸟的人吧！
say:1:1122540001:1.male: Ah! You must be the one who came to help with our terrabird problem.
say:1:1122540001:1.female: Ah! You must be the one who came to help with our terrabird problem.

say:2:1122540002:1.text: We scoured the area, but couldn't find any signs of the baby terrbirds. No clues at all...
say:2:1122540002:1.source_cn: 我们把附近翻了个遍，也没找到那些幼崽的踪迹，真是一点头...

say:5:1122540004:1.text: The hunters at the oasis camp said they saw some Quicksand Claws last night carrying little moving sacks. They must've stolen the terrabirds!
say:5:1122540004:1.source_cn: 绿洲营地那边的猎人们说，流沙之爪昨天半夜来过深红高原，...

say:6:1122540005:1.text: What?! It's those toad-eating Claws again... I'm going to make them regret ever touching my cute little terrabirds!
say:6:1122540005:1.source_cn: 什、什么？！可恶的流沙之爪……我要去找他们算账，救出可...

say:8:1122540006:1.text: Come with me! It's time to end this!
say:8:1122540006:1.male: Come with me! It's time to end this!
say:8:1122540006:1.female: Come with me! It's time to end this!
